title: DNA cleavage mechanism by metal complexes of Cu(II), Zn(II) and VO(IV) with a schiff-base ligand.
authors: Rodriguez, Maria R; Lavecchia, Martin J; Parajon-Costa, Beatriz S; Gonzalez-Baro, Ana C; Gonzalez-Baro, Maria R; Cattaneo, Elizabeth R
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过光谱、对接和MD模拟探究Cu(II)/Zn(II)/VO(IV)金属配合物与DNA的结合及切割机制，属广义蛋白-DNA互作外的金属-DNA体系，方法可迁移至TF-DNA界面建模，但对象非TF-DNA且无蛋白参与。
abstract: Metal ions and metal complexes are important components of nucleic acid biochemistry, participating both in regulation of gene expression and as therapeutic agents. Three new transition metal complexes of copper(II), zinc(II) and oxidovanadium(IV) with a ligand derived from o-vanillin and thiophene were previously synthesized and their antitumor properties were studied in our laboratory. To elucidate some molecular mechanisms tending to explain the cytotoxic effects observed over tumor cells, we investigated the interaction of these complexes with DNA by gel electrophoresis, UV-Vis spectroscopy, docking studies and molecular dynamics simulations. Our spectroscopy and computational results have shown that all of them were able to bind to DNA, Cu(II) complex is located in the minor groove while Zn(II) and oxidovanadium(IV) complexes act as major groove binding molecules. Interestingly, only the Cu(II) complex caused double-strand DNA nicks, consistent with its higher cytotoxic activities previously observed in tumor cell lines. We propose that the DNA-complex interaction destabilize the molecule either disrupting the phosphodiester bonds or impairing DNA replication, giving those complexes strong antitumor potential.
abstract_zh: 金属离子和金属配合物是核酸生物化学的重要组成部分，既参与基因表达的调控，也作为治疗剂使用。我们实验室先前合成了三种新的过渡金属配合物，分别为铜(II)、锌(II)和氧化钒(IV)，其配体源自邻香草醛和噻吩，并研究了它们的抗肿瘤性质。为了阐明一些分子机制，以解释在肿瘤细胞上观察到的细胞毒性效应，我们通过凝胶电泳、紫外-可见光谱、对接研究和分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟，研究了这些配合物与DNA的相互作用。我们的光谱和计算结果已表明，所有这些配合物都能与DNA结合，其中Cu(II)配合物位于小沟，而Zn(II)和氧化钒(IV)配合物则作为大沟结合分子发挥作用。有趣的是，只有Cu(II)配合物引起了双链DNA的切口，这与先前在肿瘤细胞系中观察到的其更高的细胞毒性活性一致。我们提出，DNA-配合物相互作用通过破坏磷酸二酯键或损害DNA复制来使分子不稳定，从而赋予这些配合物强大的抗肿瘤潜力。
